youtube.description:
Did you know U.S. businesses lose $850 billion every year by sidelining experienced workers over 50?

This is Part 1 of a 4-part series on the real cost of age discrimination in the workforce.

AARP estimates $850 billion in lost GDP annually from age discrimination. An AI hiring system paid $365,000 after rejecting every applicant over 55. Workers 55+ get training at half the rate of workers under 35. Yet Cisco found learners over 50 complete IT courses at 74% — higher than 18-25 year olds.

It's not capability. It's investment.
